description: Size every supply, return, exhaust, and outside-air segment of a connected duct network. Each terminal's requiredCfm is carried along its shortest same-system path to equipment and summed per segment; roles (main/branch/runout) are inferred. Sizes at the fixed default friction rate, or, when fan is given with segment lengthFt and fitting equivalentLengthFt, at the Manual D friction rate derived from available static pressure over the total effective length (returned as design: ASP, TEL, friction rate, longest paths). Returns per-segment recommendations, grades for segments with an existing section, and findings: missing-required-cfm, no-equipment-path, dangling-reference, mixed-system-segment, undersized, oversized, friction-rate-out-of-range, missing-equivalent-length.

fan.description: Blower data. When given, friction rate = (externalStatic − Σ componentLosses) × 100 / total effective length (longest supply + longest return effective path).

componentLossesInWg.description: Device pressure drops outside the duct runs by name (coil, filter, supply-outlet, return-grille, damper), in. w.g.

externalStaticInWg.description: Blower external static pressure at design airflow, in. w.g.

items.description: Every terminal, segment, fitting, and equipment item in the network.

airflowType.description: System. Default unknown, which is compatible with every system (typical for equipment).

connectedItemRefs.description: elementRefs this item touches; one side of each connection is enough.

elementRef.description: Unique reference other items use in connectedItemRefs.

equivalentLengthFt.description: Fittings and terminals: equivalent length of straight duct for the fitting's loss, feet (Manual D style). Counted in effective length when fan is given.

existing.description: Segments only: the drawn section, graded against the recommendation.

id.description: Caller's id for this item; echoed in results.

lengthFt.description: Segments only: measured length in feet. Required on sized segments when fan is given.

requiredCfm.description: Terminals only: design airflow in CFM.
